task: Classify each product under the HTSUS schedule in effect on the case date. Return the most specific base Chapter 1-97 code supported by the supplied facts. Exclude Chapter 99 overlays and special-program eligibility. Abstain if a decisive fact is missing.

cases.product_name: Double-walled stainless-steel tumbler with novelty lid
product_facts: The article consists of a stainless-steel tumbler, stainless-steel drinking straw, and aluminum lid.
It holds 28 fluid ounces and is designed to keep beverages cold for an extended period.
Laboratory analysis found two stainless-steel walls with a vacuum between them.
The space between the walls contains no insulating fill, and the article has no separate protective outer casing.
The 20-ounce portable vessel has a stainless-steel outer sleeve, borosilicate-glass inner, removable plastic lid, and plastic straw.
It is intended to keep cold beverages cold for an extended period and is not intended for hot liquids.
Laboratory analysis found the stainless-steel outer vessel to be double-walled and vacuum insulated.
The borosilicate glass is neither pressed nor specially tempered.

cases.product_name: Vacuum-sealed stainless-steel tumbler with sip lid
product_facts: The stainless-steel tumbler is about 6 inches high with a 3-inch top opening and a plastic insert in its base.
It has a double-walled stainless-steel receptacle with a vacuum between the walls and a patterned plastic outer covering around part of the vessel.
Its screw-on lid has small drinking holes and does not fully seal the drinking opening.
Testing showed that liquid introduced at 212 degrees Fahrenheit cooled to 158 degrees after one hour and 135 degrees after two hours.

cases.product_name: Dolomite candy-corn drinking cup with lid and spoon
product_facts: The retail package contains handled drinking cups, lids, and spoons, all made entirely of dolomite ceramic.
Each 18-ounce cup is about 5.62 inches high, with a 2.63-inch top that widens to a 3.9-inch base, and is not used with a saucer.
The cups resemble candy corn; their lids have spoon apertures, and each spoon is decorated with a jack-o'-lantern image.
The tapered cups are not straight-sided or barrel-shaped, and the decoration is not treated as a qualifying festive motif.
The drinking cup is made of dolomite ceramic and is safe for drink contact.
It is about 3.94 inches high, with a 4.25-inch open top tapering to a 2.75-inch base, and has a side handle.
It has a wavy rim, colored glaze, printed wording, and floral decoration.
It is valued at $10.08 per dozen.
